question: does the 95 u / 0.5 s rise heuristic (vet() 'rocket_jump') falsely reject legitimate stair/lift climbs? QW stairs step position up to 16 u/tick with no velocity, so a grounded stair climb can rise 96+ u in half a second.

method.cohorts: same candidate windows the extraction uses: route-lab cohort_cte_chain per registry route, gate-filtered, FULL candidate scan (no stop at n_paths=24, so counts here exceed the truncated reject counts in pipeline/out/paths/summary.json: ralow 155 -> 888 full-scan, tunnel 98 = 98 since it never reached 24 keepers)
method.diagnostics: per rocket_jump-rejected run, at every offending window (any sample pair <=500 ms apart rising >95 u): per-interval implied vz = dz/dt, step sizes, and the floor depth straight below every sample (edge_signal._floor_below, probe 512 u, hull1 points_open — a standing player reads 0-8 u, hull bottom is 24 u under origin)

classes.stair_lift: every offending window floor-supported: floor <=64 u below every sample after the window start (64 = 45.5 u plain-jump apex + 16 u step slack) -> false rejection, recovered
classes.true_rj: some window unsupported AND max implied vz >=350 u/s AND >=50 % of its samples >64 u above floor -> real rocket jump
classes.likely_rj: unsupported, one of the two supporting signals -> stays rejected
classes.ambiguous: unsupported but weak signals -> stays rejected (conservative)

method.sampling_caveat: MVD sampling is 12-77 samples/s; with dt >=40 ms a single interval can hide a rocket impulse, so implied vz is never used alone — and it cannot be: grounded stair climbs show implied vz up to ~1140 u/s from the instant 16 u position steps. The floor probe is dt-independent and is the load-bearing signal.

criterion.old: reject 'rocket_jump' iff max z-rise over any 0.5 s window > 95 u
criterion.new: reject 'rocket_jump' iff some 0.5 s window rises > 95 u AND that window is airborne: some sample after the window start hangs > 64 u above the nearest floor straight below (pipeline/human_paths.rise_is_floor_supported, FLOOR_SUPPORT_U=64, probe 512 u)
criterion.monotonic: new reject set is a subset of the old on every run — no previously accepted run can become rejected; only floor-supported (grounded) rises are recovered
criterion.implementation: pipeline/human_paths.py vet() + rise_is_floor_supported(); map probe runs only on runs the rise heuristic would already have rejected

separation_measured.recovered_stair_lift: rise 95-119 u, floor <=40 u below every sample (median 8 u = standing), window starts cluster on the RA stairs (x~340,y~-528 ralow/quad/ring; tunnel x~45,y~-530) and the SNG-side steps (x~-965,y~79 sngspawn-to-mega)
separation_measured.true_rj: rise 169-480 u, floor 136-480 u below during the rise, implied vz 517-1305 u/s
separation_measured.no_overlap: max recovered floor depth 40 u vs min unsupported window depth >64 u by construction; max recovered rise 118.6 u vs true_rj median rise 176-399 u

rl_ratop_sanity.premise: the 9 rocket_jump rejections on the rl->ratop audit pair (corpus_sufficiency.json) were treated as known true RJs
rl_ratop_sanity.finding: 7/9 are true RJs (rise 169-221 u, floor 216-400 u below, implied vz 517-662) and stay rejected. 2/9 (demo 9587, demo 4549) are grounded stair climbs the old heuristic misfiled: rise exactly 96.0 u, floor <=8 u below EVERY sample of the rise, max single step 15.8-16 u; demo 4549 max implied vz 308.8 u/s (below even a plain jump + margin). The 'known RJ' premise was itself contaminated by the heuristic under audit; no airborne rise is recovered anywhere.

run_row_format: each rj_rejected_runs entry is a JSON-encoded array in run_row_columns order
